ledger.x: 1156: the Kalachuri line of Bijjala II begins in the Chalukya south.
1162: Bijjala drives the Chalukya Taila III out of Kalyani.
1181: the Chalukyas begin to win the land back.
1184 (bridge): the last Kalachuri ruler Singhana (1183-1184) falls.
1184 (bridge): the land passes back to the Western Chalukyas.
1184 (bridge): the Kalachuri line ends with Singhana (1183-1184).

wars.name: Chalukya recovery of Kalyani
wars.outcome: "Western Chalukyas ended the Kalachuri Dynasty"; "after 1181 CE, the Chalukyas gradually retrieved the territory".

certainty.note: No frontier on either page; Kalyani, Mangalavada and the two provinces are the only places named.
